$comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-catalog.mjs from rse.manifest.json, the .d.ts files, the component sources and their CSS. Do not edit.

components.name: BrandMotif
components.summary: The official "cubo impossível" motif — the brand's central visual idea, supplied by Sesc as vector artwork and split into six constructions. Defaults to one brand family per shape; hue="original" retains supplied colours. Never re-maps per theme. Invalid variants/hues return null.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Which official construction to render (default 'cube')

props.name: size
props.doc: Rendered square size in px (default 240)

props.name: title
props.doc: Accessible label. Omit when decorative (rendered aria-hidden)

props.name: opacity
props.doc: Fade the motif when it sits behind content (default 1)

props.name: hue
props.doc: Omit for the assigned brand family; "original" preserves supplied fills; a palette family selects a derived remap.

components.name: MotifEngine
components.summary: The motif engine: builds impossible isometric shapes from lattice bars and cubes with declared crossings, and renders them as flat-filled SVG in any of the six palette families. A function library with no visual output of its own; MotifLoader and MotifPattern build on it. Also exported one function at a time.

components.name: MotifPattern
components.summary: A field of impossible shapes that fills its container (display:block, width and height 100%: the host sets the size). `animate` is 'none' (static, default), 'reveal' (cells fade in by --d stagger when the pattern scrolls into view; needs motion.js, never hidden without it) or 'ambient' (a slow breathing loop with a mandatory pause button). Text never sits on the cells: put it on a solid panel. An unknown shape or hue renders nothing. Follows the motion setting: reveal is opacity only and ambient is static when reduced.

props.name: width
props.doc: Width of the drawing box, px (default 1920). Only the proportion matters: the art is scaled to fill the host

props.name: height
props.doc: Height of the drawing box, px (default 1080)

props.name: className
props.doc: Extra class on the root, e.g. one that gives the host its size

components.name: PlatformEntry
components.summary: Co-branded entry point from a Rede Sesc de Educação surface into the Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA. One click from a marketing page to the platform's home — see docs/sabia-platform.md.

props.name: href
props.doc: Where the platform lives. Ask Sesc for the real URL — the default # is a placeholder.

props.name: logoSrc
props.doc: Sab.IA lockup, e.g. assets/logos/sabia-wordmark-cream.svg on purple

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Uppercase label shown when no logoSrc is given

props.name: tone
props.doc: purple = solid Sab.IA purple band; cream = quiet block on a cream page

props.name: note
props.doc: Small print under the description (audience, access conditions)

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Circular image or initials with optional decorative presence dot. Class contract: .rse-avatar.

props.name: src
props.doc: Photo URL; when omitted, initials are shown

props.name: initials
props.doc: 1-2 letter fallback shown when no src

props.name: status
props.doc: Optional presence dot

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Small status pill with a dot. Class contract: .rse-badge--<tone>.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Action button (or link styled as one) with 3 variants and 3 sizes. Class contract: .rse-button. Accepts every native attribute and a ref.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual style

props.name: size
props.doc: Size

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional leading icon element, usually an <Icon>

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders an <a> that looks like a button. With disabled, the link is removed and aria-disabled set.

props.name: block
props.doc: Full width

components.name: Card
components.summary: Program/school card: media, eyebrow, title, description, footer. Class contract: .rse-card.

props.name: image
props.doc: Optional media element (e.g. or ) rendered at 16:10

props.name: tag
props.doc: Optional Tag/Badge element shown above the eyebrow

props.name: footer
props.doc: Actions or meta below the body; stays independently clickable

props.name: href
props.doc: Makes the title a link whose hit area covers the whole card

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level of the title (default 3)

components.name: CtaBand
components.summary: A full-bleed call-to-action band: headline, one line of support and the caller's buttons.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Band colour: primary/indigo (white text), ink (on-ink text), accents (ink text)

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short uppercase line above the title

props.name: title
props.doc: The call to action headline

props.name: description
props.doc: One supporting sentence

props.name: align
props.doc: Alignment of the content block

props.name: as
props.doc: Heading element for the title; pick the level that fits the page outline

props.name: children
props.doc: Actions: compose Button components here

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Horizontal or vertical separator, optionally with a centred label. Class contract: .rse-divider.

props.name: label
props.doc: Optional centered label (horizontal only), e.g. "ou"

components.name: Hero
components.summary: The opening block of a page: eyebrow, the one h1, a lead, buttons and optional media in two columns that collapse to one.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Surface: page (default, no fill), card (white), or a band tone (primary/indigo white text, ink on-ink text, accents ink text)

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short uppercase line above the title

props.name: title
props.doc: The page headline

props.name: lead
props.doc: One supporting paragraph, capped at the prose width

props.name: badge
props.doc: Node beside the eyebrow, e.g. a Badge or Tag with the enrollment deadline

props.name: media
props.doc: Media node, e.g. <image-slot placeholder="…">. Hero never renders a default image; without it the layout is one column

props.name: mediaPosition
props.doc: Which side the media sits on when there are two columns

props.name: as
props.doc: Heading element for the title. Default h1: a page has exactly one, so use h2 if the page already has one

props.name: children
props.doc: Actions: compose Button components here

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Line-icon primitive — the single source of truth for iconography. 24×24 grid, 2px stroke, inherits `currentColor`. Pass to Button/IconButton via `icon`. Returns null for an unknown name, so a typo fails visibly in review rather than rendering a broken glyph.

props.name: name
props.doc: Which glyph to render

props.name: size
props.doc: Pixel size (width & height), default 20

props.name: strokeWidth
props.doc: Stroke weight, default 2 — the grid these icons are drawn on

props.name: color
props.doc: Stroke colour; defaults to currentColor so it inherits text colour

props.name: title
props.doc: Accessible label. Omit for decorative icons (rendered aria-hidden)

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Icon-only round button. Class contract: .rse-icon-button. Accepts every native attribute and a ref.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible label for the icon-only button (required — there is no visible text). Also accepts the native `aria-label`.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Accent chip on a pale tint with its paired ink. Class contract: .rse-tag--<hue>.

props.name: onRemove
props.doc: Shows a remove button

props.name: removeLabel
props.doc: Accessible label of the remove button (default "Remover")

components.name: Testimonial
components.summary: A single static testimonial as figure, blockquote and figcaption. Never invent one: use example while the text is a placeholder.

props.name: quote
props.doc: The quoted text, without quotation marks (the CSS adds the pt-BR ones)

props.name: name
props.doc: Who said it

props.name: role
props.doc: Role or relationship, e.g. "responsável", "ex-estudante"

props.name: unit
props.doc: Unit or programme the person is tied to

props.name: avatar
props.doc: Avatar node; the caller passes an <Avatar>

props.name: example
props.doc: Marks the testimonial as a placeholder: shows a visible "Depoimento de exemplo" pill (read by screen readers too). Default false

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Rounded, card-surface table for schedules, unit lists, fees and program comparisons. Horizontally scrollable on narrow screens.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Row objects keyed by column key; values may be nodes (Tags, Badges, links)

props.name: caption
props.doc: Optional eyebrow caption above the table

props.name: zebra
props.doc: Alternate row tint (default true)

props.name: compact
props.doc: Tighter row height for dense schedules

components.name: Stat
components.summary: A single impact figure with uppercase label. Compose 3–4 in a flex/grid band to show the Rede reach.

props.name: value
props.doc: The figure itself, pre-formatted: 1.200, 97%, +38 mil

props.name: label
props.doc: Short uppercase label under the figure

props.name: description
props.doc: Optional supporting sentence

props.name: accent
props.doc: Figure colour — use inverse on purple bands

components.name: StatBand
components.summary: A full-bleed band of 3–4 Stat figures in a fluid grid, announced as a list.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Band colour: primary/indigo (white text), ink (on-ink text), accents (ink text)

props.name: title
props.doc: Visible heading, rendered as an uppercase eyebrow; also names the section for screen readers. Without it, pass aria-label.

props.name: note
props.doc: Small text under the figures: source, date, or the placeholder warning

props.name: children
props.doc: Stat components; each becomes one list item

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Expand/collapse list for FAQs and long-form program details. Animated with grid-template-rows so panel height is automatic.

props.name: allowMultiple
props.doc: Allow several panels open at once (default: single-open)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Indices open on first render

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Persistent inline banner with a tone icon. Class contract: .rse-alert--<tone>.

props.name: message
props.doc: The message (children also work)

props.name: urgent
props.doc: Interrupts screen readers (role="alert"). Default is role="status".

props.name: dismissLabel
props.doc: Accessible label of the dismiss button (default "Fechar")

components.name: MotifLoader
components.summary: Primary branded loading feedback for buttons, inline waits and whole sections. Generated motif pieces assemble and release; reduced motion uses a slower opacity-only build.

props.name: shape
props.doc: Shape to assemble. Defaults to cube for sections, triangle for inline. Invalid names render nothing

props.name: hue
props.doc: Palette family (default 'purple'). An unknown name renders nothing

props.name: hues
props.doc: 2 to 4 families to step through, one per cycle. Any other length uses `hue`

props.name: variant
props.doc: Section feedback (48 px, palette facets) or compact inline feedback (24 px, monochrome)

props.name: tone
props.doc: Inline foreground: primary for light surfaces; inverse for primary/ink bands and buttons

props.name: size
props.doc: Width and height in px. Below 32 automatically uses compact inline rendering

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name announced to screen readers, in pt-BR (default 'Carregando')

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: Determinate progress track exposed as `role="progressbar"` with aria-valuenow/min/max.

props.name: label
props.doc: Optional caption shown above the track, with the % on the right

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name when there is no visible `label` (default "Progresso")

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Loading placeholder with a slow shimmer. Mirror the shape of the content that will replace it.

props.name: variant
props.doc: text = stacked lines; rect / card / circle = single block

props.name: width
props.doc: CSS width (default 100%, or 48px for circle)

props.name: lines
props.doc: Line count for variant text

props.name: radius
props.doc: Override border radius with a --rse-radius-* token reference

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Compatibility wrapper for MotifLoader inline mode. Prefer MotifLoader for new loading feedback. Uses managed reduced motion, not a separate rotating ring.

props.name: size
props.doc: Diameter in px

props.name: tone
props.doc: Use "inverse" on purple/ink backgrounds

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Transient notification card with a tone accent; announced as role="status", or role="alert" for danger. Class contract: .rse-toast--<tone>.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Hover and focus label for a trigger (icon buttons, truncated text); dismissed with Escape. Class contract: .rse-tooltip.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Checkbox. A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-checkbox.

components.name: DateField
components.summary: Native date input styled to match Input, with an optional deadline pill for enrollment windows.

props.name: value
props.doc: ISO date string (yyyy-mm-dd)

props.name: min
props.doc: Earliest selectable ISO date

props.name: max
props.doc: Latest selectable ISO date

props.name: helpText
props.doc: Alias of hint

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message — replaces hint, sets aria-invalid and is announced

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit id; otherwise generated with React.useId

props.name: deadline
props.doc: Optional deadline pill under the field, e.g. Inscrições até 28/02

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: Drag-and-drop document upload for enrollment paperwork, with an attached-file list and per-file removal.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Helper text below the drop zone

props.name: accept
props.doc: Accept attribute, e.g. .pdf,.jpg

props.name: files
props.doc: Currently attached files (controlled)

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message — replaces hint, turns the border red, sets aria-invalid on the file input and is announced

props.name: maxSizeLabel
props.doc: Size limit shown in the drop zone, e.g. até 5 MB

props.name: id
props.doc: Explicit id prefix for label/message wiring; otherwise React.useId

props.name: dropLabel
props.doc: Instruction inside the drop zone. Default: 'Arraste os arquivos ou clique para escolher'

props.name: acceptHint
props.doc: Format hint shown when neither accept nor maxSizeLabel is set. Default: 'PDF, JPG ou PNG'

components.name: FilterChips
components.summary: Pill toggle group for filtering program, level and unit listings. Use above a results grid, never as a form field.

props.name: options
props.doc: Chip options — plain strings or objects with a count

props.name: value
props.doc: Selected ids

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Allow multiple selections (default true)

props.name: label
props.doc: Uppercase group label

props.name: showClear
props.doc: Show the Limpar reset link when anything is selected

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text field with label, helper text and error, wired for screen readers. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-input. Every other prop goes to the <input>; className goes to the field wrapper.

props.name: helpText
props.doc: Helper text below the field (alias: hint)

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message — replaces the helper text, sets aria-invalid and is announced with the field

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Radio button — group several with the same name. A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-radio.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Native select with the system's field chrome. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-select.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Disabled first option shown until a value is picked

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Progress indicator for multi-step flows: enrollment, document upload, application review.

props.name: steps
props.doc: Step labels, or objects with an optional description

props.name: current
props.doc: Zero-based index of the current step; earlier steps render as complete

props.name: onStepClick
props.doc: Makes step markers clickable (e.g. to revisit a completed step)

components.name: Switch
components.summary: On/off switch (role=switch). A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-switch.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text field matching Input, with optional hint, error and character counter. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-textarea.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Helper text below the field (alias: helpText)

props.name: error
props.doc: Error message — replaces the hint and sets aria-invalid

props.name: maxLength
props.doc: Enables the character counter (needs a controlled value)

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Navigation trail with a non-link current page. Class contract: .rse-breadcrumb.

props.name: items
props.doc: Trail from the home page to the current page; the last item renders as the current page, not a link

components.name: Footer
components.summary: Ink-surface site footer: brand block, responsive link columns and a legal note.

props.name: logoSrc
props.doc: Logo image URL (use the white wordmark on the ink surface)

props.name: tagline
props.doc: One line under the logo

props.name: columns
props.doc: Link columns; the grid reflows to as many as fit, one per row on a phone

props.name: note
props.doc: Legal line below a divider

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Dropdown menu for navigation and actions: regional unit pickers, Programas nav sections, row actions. Closes on outside click and Escape.

props.name: label
props.doc: Trigger text

props.name: width
props.doc: Panel width in px (default 260)

props.name: trigger
props.doc: Pill button (default) or bare nav link

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled open state

components.name: Navbar
components.summary: Sticky site header: logo, text links and one call to action; wraps instead of overflowing (no drawer yet, roadmap P3.2).

props.name: logoSrc
props.doc: Logo image URL

props.name: logoDarkSrc
props.doc: White lockup for dark surfaces. Optional; CSS follows the nearest explicit theme or auto mode

props.name: logoAlt
props.doc: Alt text for the logo

props.name: links
props.doc: Text links; they wrap onto their own row on narrow screens

props.name: activeHref
props.doc: The link whose href matches gets aria-current="page" and the primary colour

props.name: ctaLabel
props.doc: Call-to-action label; omit for no button

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page navigation for long result lists. Class contract: .rse-pagination.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Pill tab bar for switching sections. Implements the ARIA tablist pattern: roving tabIndex, `aria-selected`, and Left/Right/Home/End keyboard navigation. The tab list scrolls sideways inside itself on narrow screens. Class contract: .rse-tabs, __list, __tab, __panel.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name for the tab bar (default "Seções")

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Centred dialog on a dimmed backdrop: traps focus, closes on Escape and returns focus to the trigger. Class contract: .rse-modal--<size>.

classes.doc: a wrapping row (buttons, tags, meta) with one gap; or set --rse-cluster-gap.
page width (--rse-container-xl) with the fluid side padding. --prose / --md / --lg narrow it to the matching --rse-container-* token.
the eyebrow label: Bold, uppercase, eyebrow tracking, primary colour — the only uppercase in the system (AGENTS.md, rule 3).
auto-fit columns, no fixed column count: as many as fit at --rse-grid-min (default 17.5rem), one column on a phone. Set --rse-grid-min / --rse-grid-gap.
vertical rhythm between major blocks (--rse-section-y-md; -sm below md). Consecutive sections share one gap. A section with its own surface is a band (CtaBand, StatBand), not .rse-section.
vertical flow with one gap. --sm / --lg change the gap; or set --rse-stack-gap.
